facts.fact: MEASURE Evaluation's country profile, as of August 2019 and on an in-country contact, records a national deployment of DHIS2 used for aggregating health data from all facilities within the country.

MEASURE Evaluation's country profile gives 100% of public health facilities as reporting through DHIS2, for 2016 to 2018, on the 2016-2018 Master Facility List and an in-country contact; it gives no numerator or denominator, and does not say where the reports are keyed.

MEASURE Evaluation's country profile, as of August 2019, lists the HIS strategic plan as current, being the eHealth Strategy of Botswana 2016-2020, while also recording that the eHealth strategy was completed but not officially launched and that no HIS policy or national HIS coordinating body was available; the profile does not say the strategy names DHIS2.

MEASURE Evaluation's country profile, as of August 2019 and on an in-country contact, states that all hospitals are on a centralised Integrated Patient Management System, used in hospitals only to collect patient diagnostic information.

MEASURE Evaluation's country profile, as of August 2019, states that the Integrated Patient Management System is used in hospitals only and that other public facilities use a stand-alone system, with a Patient Management System used in clinics with the maternity sector.
